macros.name: FirstFrameCommand
macros.doc: Unbroken text is adorned by \FrameCommand, whereas split text first uses \FirstFrameCommand, possibly followed by \MidFrameCommand, and finishing with \LastFrameCommand.

macros.name: FrameCommand
macros.doc: The “framed” environment uses \fbox, by default, as its \FrameCommand with the additional settings \fboxrule=\FrameRule and \fboxsep=\FrameSep.
